from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace')
d=(base/'programs'); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==3]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    seeds=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1]
    # The lone interior 3 is the center from which even-radius square outlines grow.
    sr,sc=seeds[0]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if (r,c)!=(sr,sc):
                g[r][c]=4
    radius=2
    while sr-radius>=r0+1 or sr+radius<=r1-1 or sc-radius>=c0+1 or sc+radius<=c1-1:
        for r in range(max(r0+1,sr-radius),min(r1-1,sr+radius)+1):
            for c in range(max(c0+1,sc-radius),min(c1-1,sc+radius)+1):
                if max(abs(r-sr),abs(c-sc))==radius:
                    g[r][c]=2
        radius+=2
    g[sr][sc]=3
    return g
'''
path=d/'task-c4e6a6d7.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
